svg.title: Pyroptotic Cell — Schematic — Pore-bearing cell
svg.desc: A swollen cell bearing several symbolic gasdermin pore rings. Gasdermin ring symbols communicate a mechanism, not microscopy-resolved pore number, scale, subunit count or a diagnostic morphology. The drawing does not specify inflammatory caspase, gasdermin family member, cytokine identity or experimental evidence.
